logic: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a landscape white-background engineering review reference, crisp readable English lettering, restrained navy line art with teal accents. This is an IDEAL CONCEPT image, not a certified engineering drawing. No Chinese. No decorative gradients, no photos, no watermark. Fill the frame with legible content. Draw a compact 1-bit full adder schematic. Inputs A, B, Cin; outputs Sum, Cout. Exactly five gates: XOR1(A,B)=s1; XOR2(s1,Cin)=Sum; AND1(A,B)=c1; AND2(s1,Cin)=c2; OR1(c1,c2)=Cout. Organize in three clear left-to-right stages. ANSI gate silhouettes have opaque white bodies; no wires visible through a gate. Orthogonal wires, generous label clearance, connection dots ONLY on true branch junctions; crossings without junction dots are not connections. Title "Full adder — readable routing". Small footer "Concept reference • topology must be verified". Preserve exactly the five gates and all three inputs.
pid: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a landscape white-background engineering review reference, crisp readable English lettering, restrained navy line art with teal accents. This is an IDEAL CONCEPT image, not a certified engineering drawing. No Chinese. No decorative gradients, no photos, no watermark. Fill the frame with legible content. Draw a P&ID concept for water treatment. Main process spine: TK-101 Raw water tank -> P-101 Transfer pump -> F-101 Media filter -> XV-101 Motor valve -> TK-102 Clear water tank. Below: TK-201 Chemical day tank -> P-201 Diaphragm dosing pump -> TOP port of F-101. TK-301 Backwash water -> dedicated side backwash port of F-101. F-101 bottom drain port -> TK-401 Drain sump. Above XV-101 put FIC-101 controller with dashed electrical signal to motor actuator M. Dashed rounded frame labelled "FILTER SKID" encloses F-101, XV-101 and FIC-101 only. Lines freely cross frame; all other tanks and pumps outside. Service legend distinguishes Main process (solid dark), Chemical dosing (teal double-dash plus label), Backwash (blue dashed plus label), Drain (gray dotted plus label); these are conceptual service styles not a formal standards claim. Keep full equipment IDs, no duplicated equipment. Title "Package membership + service identity". Footer "Concept reference • not renderer output".

breadboard: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a landscape white-background engineering review reference, crisp readable English lettering, restrained navy line art with teal accents. This is an IDEAL CONCEPT image, not a certified engineering drawing. No Chinese. No decorative gradients, no photos, no watermark. Fill the frame with legible content. Create a precise educational diagram of a TL072 DIP-8 on a horizontal breadboard straddling rows e (above center channel) and f (below). Show columns 15,16,17,18 left to right. Chip notch faces LEFT. Pin 1 dot at BOTTOM LEFT. Lower side f has pins 1,2,3,4 left to right; upper side e has pins 8,7,6,5 left to right. Exactly 8 pins, each clearly labelled. Show enlarged breadboard rows a,b,c,d,e above channel and f,g,h,i,j below channel. At right draw an exact mapping table: 1 OUT A 15f; 2 IN− A 16f; 3 IN+ A 17f; 4 V− 18f; 5 IN+ B 18e; 6 IN− B 17e; 7 OUT B 16e; 8 V+ 15e. Highlight pin 8 and hole 15e teal with a short leader. Add separate small inset depicting two electrically disconnected power-rail segments with a visibly missing jumper, caption "A split rail is not one net". Title "TL072 — orientation before wiring". Footer "Concept reference • exact mapping checked separately".
opamp: Use case: infographic-diagram. Landscape engineering concept reference on pure white, English labels only, crisp black/navy line art. Draw an ideal readable non-inverting LM741 amplifier, WITHOUT inventing a voltage source for missing data. Input source 1 Vpk 1 kHz goes to + input; output feeds R1 10k back to minus input, R2 2.2k from minus input to ground; Rload 1k from output to ground. Explicit supply pins V+ to +15V and V− to −15V. One opaque op-amp triangle, input pins clear at upper/lower left, output at right; feedback resistor above triangle; compact orthogonal paths, no edge through symbols or labels. True junction dot at minus input/R1/R2 meeting and output/feedback/load meeting only. Title "LM741 — explicit feedback and supply pins". Footer "Proposed corrected intent • original feedback net was disconnected". All labels readable at 500px display width. No Chinese, no arbitrary extra components.

edits.logic: Create a corrected edition of this reference. Preserve clean typography and five-gate structure, but replace ALL long interconnecting wires with SHORT NAMED NET STUBS so there is no chance of a false junction. Each gate has two left input stubs and one right output stub, each labelled: XOR1 input A and B output s1; XOR2 input s1 and Cin output Sum; AND1 input A and B output c1; AND2 input s1 and Cin output c2; OR1 input c1 and c2 output Cout. Exactly five gates. No line connects A to Cin. All connections expressed by matching net labels only, no long wires between gates. Footer "Named-net layout reference • exact truth table tested separately".
edits.pid: Correct service piping only. The teal chemical dosing pipe from P-201 must go to the TOP port of F-101; connect its currently disconnected top stub to P-201. The blue backwash pipe from TK-301 must go to the LOWER LEFT SIDE port of F-101 (where teal previously entered). The dotted gray drain leaves the BOTTOM port of F-101 and goes ONLY to TK-401. These three lines MUST be separate, do not share trunks/junctions. Keep all equipment IDs, package boundary, motor actuator and main process unchanged.
edits.opamp: Correct this non-inverting amplifier reference. The feedback resistor R1 is incorrectly connected to the plus/input node. CHANGE the feedback loop so R1 runs from the OUTPUT junction, over the TOP of the diagram, then down the LEFT side ending at the MINUS INPUT/R2 junction. It MUST cross the Vin-to-plus horizontal wire WITHOUT connecting (small bridge hump or clear gap). Keep Vin connected ONLY to plus input. Keep minus input connected ONLY to R1 and R2. Preserve all seven circuit elements, labels, supply pins, and title. Remove junction dot on Vin wire where feedback crosses. Draw a junction dot where R1 joins minus input and R2. This exact correction is essential.

secondEdits.pid: Use this image as composition reference but SIMPLIFY auxiliary connections to NAMED OFF-PAGE CONNECTORS. Keep all tanks, pumps, frame, motor valve and main process. Remove all long colored auxiliary routes entirely. Add a short teal output stub on P-201 labelled DOSE; a short teal input stub on F-101 TOP labelled DOSE. Add a short blue output stub on TK-301 labelled BACKWASH; short blue input stub on F-101 SIDE labelled BACKWASH. Add a short gray output stub on F-101 BOTTOM labelled DRAIN; short gray input stub on TK-401 TOP labelled DRAIN. Matching names express continuity. KEEP TK-201 -> P-201 connected with teal pipe. No loose unlabeled stubs. No blue/teal shared line. Footer "Named service connectors • composition reference, not renderer output". The labels MUST be on the correct stubs.
secondEdits.opamp: Redraw this same non-inverting amplifier with a crossing-free composition. Opamp triangle points RIGHT. MINUS input is UPPER LEFT; PLUS input LOWER LEFT. R1 10k feedback goes from OUTPUT at right, straight UP, then LEFT across the TOP through R1, then DOWN to the UPPER LEFT minus input junction. R2 2.2k goes LEFT from that minus-input junction then down to ground, never crossing another wire. Vin 1Vpk 1kHz sits LOWER LEFT and connects straight horizontally to LOWER LEFT PLUS input; its other terminal goes to ground. Rload 1k from output down to ground. Supply pins V+ +15V above triangle, V− −15V below triangle. Do NOT connect Vin to feedback. Keep exact same labels and component count. No crossing, no bridge humps. Title LM741 — explicit feedback and supply pins. Footer Concept reference — verify the netlist.
